# Knowledge index

The single place to look things up. Read `CLAUDE.md` first if you have not.

How to use it: find the idea below (by its name, or by any other name it goes by: each concept lists them after *Also*), or find the question under **Questions already answered**, then open the file it points to. Concept files end with the exact section files to load. Document codes are listed first; every document has a `CODE-00-contents.md` with one row per section file. What still needs working out (questions, choices, holes) is not knowledge: it is on the agenda, `agenda/00-AGENDA.md`.

Tiers: **prime**: The prime document. Stands on its own: every part is explained fully enough to understand without opening anything else. **foundation**: Why the project exists and what counts as in scope. **deep-dive**: One area in full depth. Authoritative for its topic. **analysis**: A dated analysis. Accurate as of its date. **reference**: Reference material and registries. **source**: A primary capture (an idea as it first arrived). Immutable; analysis lives elsewhere. **history**: A conversation the project grew out of. Thinking in progress: where it disagrees with the prime document or a deep-dive, the document wins.
